notes: 修复 post-exit.ps1 丢 UTF-8 BOM 致排队同步全崩：0.3.94 编辑脚本时丢了 UTF-8 BOM，Windows PowerShell 5.1 按 GBK 解码→中文全角括号被解成引号→55 处语法错→脚本启动即崩，导致所有排队同步（启动首检/2分钟复查/点×触发）全部失效。这次把三处 post-exit.ps1 执行体（插件 runtime、配置仓库镜像、部署目录）用 UTF8Encoding($true) 补回 BOM，ParseFile 语法错从 55 降到 0；selftest 新增全量 runtime/*.ps1 必须带 BOM 的断言防回归；打包核验包内 post-exit.ps1 带 BOM。0.3.93 点×判一次 + 0.3.94 清僵死锁的修复都保留。
notesEn: Fix post-exit.ps1 losing UTF-8 BOM, which crashed every queued sync: 0.3.94 stripped the BOM while editing the script; Windows PowerShell 5.1 decoded it as GBK → full-width Chinese parentheses became quotes → 55 syntax errors → the script crashed on launch, so every queued sync (startup check, 2-minute recheck, ×-close trigger) failed. This restores the BOM on all three post-exit.ps1 executors (plugin runtime, config-repo mirror, deployed dir) with UTF8Encoding($true); ParseFile syntax errors drop from 55 to 0; selftest adds a full runtime/*.ps1 BOM assertion to prevent regression; the packed tarball is verified to contain a post-exit.ps1 with BOM. Keeps the 0.3.93 close-click check and 0.3.94 stale-watcher lock fix.
